name: Final Spite
text:
Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger A creature reduces you or a living ally within 30 feet to 0 Hit Points.

---
You can trigger this action even while Dying. You can channel the power of death into a poisonous spite. The triggering creature takes 4d4 persistent,poison damage with a basic Fortitude save save against your spell DC. If the creature kills you or your ally as part of the trigger, the creature gets a result one degree of success worse than it rolls on this save.
